verdict.rationale: Runpod documents an S3-protocol compatible API for direct access to network volumes, so files can be managed without launching a Pod. Its open-source runpodctl CLI explicitly supports transferring files between your system and Runpod, agent skills can also transfer files, and Pods carry no ingress/egress fees. Missing for 10: evidenced cloud-storage sync with external providers, detail on the S3 API's supported operations and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer performance.
